title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to flow/pass custom field values from Sales Order to Production Order
summary: Explains how to carry custom field values from a Sales Order to the Production Order created from it by subscribing to events raised in codeunit 99000792 Create Prod. Order from Sale. One event handles header to header mapping and another handles line to line mapping, with sample AL code including table and page extensions.
key_points: Use event OnAfterCreateProdOrderFromSalesLine to pass values from Sales Header to Production Order header
Use event OnCreateProductionOrderOnBeforeProdOrderLineModify to pass values from Sales Line to Production Order Line
Extend both source (Sales Header/Line) and target (Production Order/Line) tables to add custom fields
Subscribe to standard events without modifying core codeunit logic
features: Production Order creation from Sales Order
Item Order and Project Order types
